answer: Bind every agent identity to a hardware root of trust: at registration the agent's TPM emits a cipher-signed attestation quote sealing its on-chain key, and earned reputation stacks like shale strata, glued to that same device-bound key. A sybil attacker cannot mint thousands of identities from one server, because each new identity demands another distinct hardware quote -- the marginal cost of a fake agent becomes the price of a device. Identities that fail to renew attestation before each epoch's dawn are pruned, so rented or emulated hardware cannot linger.
